title: Evaluating LLM-based Agents for Multi-Turn Conversations: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2503.22458v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This survey examines evaluation methods for large language model (LLM)-based agents in multi-turn conversational settings. Using a PRISMA-inspired framework, we systematically reviewed nearly 250 scholarly sources, capturing the state of the art from various venues of publication, and establishing a solid foundation for our analysis. Our study offers a structured approach by developing two interrelated taxonomy systems: one that defines \emph{what to evaluate} and another that explains \emph{how to evaluate}. The first taxonomy identifies key components of LLM-based agents for multi-turn conversations and their evaluation dimensions, including task completion, response quality, user experience, memory and context retention, as well as planning and tool integration. translated_title: 评估基于大语言模型的多轮对话智能体：一项综述
translated_abstract: 本综述考察了在多轮对话环境中对基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的评估方法。我们采用受PRISMA启发的框架，系统地回顾了近250篇学术文献，涵盖了各类出版渠道的最新研究进展，为我们的分析奠定了坚实的基础。我们的研究通过构建两个相互关联的分类体系提供了结构化的方法：一个定义了“评估什么”，另一个解释了“如何评估”。第一个分类体系识别了面向多轮对话的LLM智能体的关键组件及其评估维度，包括任务完成度、响应质量、用户体验、记忆与上下文保持，以及规划与工具集成。这些组件确保以全面且有意义的方式评估对话智能体的性能。第二个分类体系则聚焦于评估（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本综述基于近250篇文献，提出了两个相互关联的分类体系——“评估什么”与“如何评估”——为多轮对话中基于大语言模型的智能体评估提供了系统性的结构化框架。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews nearly 250 scholarly sources and proposes two interrelated taxonomies—defining "what to evaluate" and "how to evaluate"—establishing a structured framework for assessing LLM-based agents in multi-turn conversational settings.
